notes: meResponse returns the AUTHENTICATED user (gcid + realCid + demoCid). Use it to discover your own customer IDs.
User is the lightweight profile shape used inside posts/comments/feeds/copy-metadata.
PublicAggregatedInfoUser is the rich profile (30 fields) with verification status, account state, GDPR info, copy-trading attributes.

Three integer-encoded enums embedded here: AccountStatus (2 variants), PlayerStatus (15 variants), PlayerStatusReason (43 variants 0-42). Wire format is the integer; consider Rust enum + #[serde(into=u32, try_from=u32)] or store as raw integer with a lookup table.
UserRole is also an integer-encoded enum (11 variants): Regular, PI, Moderator, Anonymous, eToroTeam, eTorian, CopyPortfolio, Depositor, Admin, Verified, Analyst.
Note casing: meResponse uses lowercase 'cid' (gcid/realCid/demoCid) but PublicAggregatedInfoUser uses 'CID' (realCID/demoCID/masterAccountCid). Same concept, different shape per endpoint.
User.roles is an array of strings — but UserRole standalone is type:integer. The same enum is wire-encoded differently in different contexts.
